main_text.p: atque iterum clade consternata in clien-tela Venetorum mediocri fortuna ad præsens hoc sæculum Corcyra floruit.
main_text.head: IX. DE SAMO ET EIVS REPVBLICA.
main_text.p: [illegible, ~4 letters]SAMVS urbs antiquissima & clarissima, eademque olim præpotens, sita in insula cognomine, non procul ab orâ Asiæ minoris, quæ Ionia dicitur, disjuncta, quæ in ambitu habebat stadia quasi Dcc:quam dictam plerique putant ab altitudine, (hoc enim vocabuli hujus significatum veteribus:) Tota enim quasi in mon-tem se attollit. Quanquàm alii à primis[illegible, ~5 letters] habitatoribus Græcis è Samo Cephale-niæ profectis, quæ & ipsa situ sublimis fuit, sic nuncupatam arbitrentur. Vitibus infœlix, arboribus frugiferis, & satis fœlicissima, si Straboni credimus, qui major fide quàm Apuleius, qui diver-sum tradit. Epheso ac Ephesiæ oræ & promontorio montis Micales, à quo freto stadiorum xl sejungitur, vicina, nec longè remota ab insula Icariâ, quam ad Occidentem intuetur, dictam verò

page.notes: The first line is the end of a paragraph begun on the previous page. The right margin has faint, mostly illegible fragments of marginal notes beside the lines "primis" and "Asiæ"; the three notes are approximate placements and their letters could not be read. Possible doubtful readings: "consternata" (the scan may show a long s in "conlternata"). "Epheso" is printed with the long-s form, written here with plain s. "Dcc:quam" is copied as printed. Last line "dictam verò" is followed by "Asiæ" at the lower right, recorded as the catchword.
